_about: Which sounds go into which uploaded file. Roblox counts every upload against a monthly limit (10 a month without ID verification, 100 with it, per a Roblox staff post of May 2024), so cars share files. Each car still gets its own sheet table in VehicleAudio/Sheets. Uploads must be under 20 MB and 7 minutes; limits below keep a margin. See docs/AUDIO.md.
